How to use Thalès

For French speakers in the United States, Canada and Europe who want to understand options and trade them with a method, starting from zero.

Open Thalès ↗Platform detailsContact

Guided tourReal screens

Plays automatically. Use the dots or arrows to move, Pause to stop.

01

Getting started

1

Go to thales-options.vercel.app and read the home page: what an option is, how a trade unfolds and how to start.

2

Click Se connecter, then Créer mon compte: an email address and a password of eight characters or more.

3

Subscribe for $10 a month on the Stripe page; you come back to the school with your access open.

4

Open My account and join the subscribers' WhatsApp group.

5

Follow the first month: basics, simulator, lab, then a first small real trade.

02

Features

01

Visual basics and lessons

Who pays whom in an option, a trade followed from Monday to Friday, then twelve lessons with figures on real American companies.

STEPS

  1. Open Learn, then The basics in pictures
  2. Read one lesson a day
  3. Check yourself with the ten-question quiz
02

Simulator

Eight weeks of market on Apple, Nike, Coca-Cola, Ford and the S&P 500, with $500, $5,000 or $10,000 of fake money and a chain of options priced live.

STEPS

  1. Choose a market and a capital, then New game
  2. Tap a price in the chain to buy or sell a contract
  3. Move with Next day or Go to Friday
03

Strategy lab

Draws the gain and loss of a strategy against Friday's price, with breakeven, maximum loss and probability of profit.

STEPS

  1. Pick a strategy
  2. Set the price, volatility and days left
  3. Read the breakeven and the maximum loss
04

AI agents and Moneta

Ten lessons on connecting Claude, ChatGPT or Codex to a dedicated Robinhood account, and Moneta, an assistant that answers questions in French.

STEPS

  1. Open AI agents
  2. Follow the lessons in order
  3. Ask Moneta from the button at the bottom right
05

The book

Options hebdomadaires, read online: a free foreword, a twenty-four-chapter plan and the first chapters, with text size, cream or night page, a section rail and reading that resumes where it stopped.

STEPS

  1. Read the free foreword
  2. Buy the book for $25 once
  3. Use Aa for size and background
06

My account

Subscription and book status, the WhatsApp group link for subscribers, and the Stripe page to manage or cancel.

STEPS

  1. Open My account
  2. Join the group
  3. Manage or cancel the subscription
03Tips
  • Do not skip the simulator: errors there cost nothing.
  • Never enter a trade without knowing its maximum loss.
  • An option you sell is always covered, by shares or by cash.
04FAQ
Do I need money to start?

No. The simulator uses fake money.

Can I cancel?

Yes, at any time from My account; access stays open to the end of the paid month.

Is the book included?

No. It is sold separately, $25 once.

Is this investment advice?

No. Thalès is a school; your decisions remain yours.
